test.name: tsf-k8s-ts
test.objective: Kubernetes API and kubelet security suite

test.name: k8s
test.objective: Kubernetes API and kubelet security audits

test.name: prologue
test.objective: Bring a single-node k3s cluster up in Docker; skip the group if it will not come up

test.name: anon_api
test.objective: SECURITY: anonymous reads of the API server must be denied

iter.notes: The secure cluster denies every anonymous sensitive read (403); only /version is served, as INFO.

KNOWN FINDING (control). With cluster-admin bound to system:anonymous, the API server serves Secrets and the rest of the inventory to an unauthenticated peer. A SKIPPED here means Docker/k3s was not available.

test.name: rbac
test.objective: SECURITY: the authorizer must grant system:anonymous none of the dangerous verbs

iter.notes: The secure cluster allows system:anonymous none of the dangerous verb/resource pairs.
KNOWN FINDING (control). With cluster-admin bound to system:anonymous, the authorizer answers "yes" to every dangerous check. A SKIPPED here means Docker/k3s was not available.

test.name: anon_kubelet
test.objective: SECURITY: the kubelet must reject unauthenticated reads

iter.notes: The prologue cluster's kubelet rejects anonymous reads (401).

KNOWN FINDING (control). A throwaway cluster whose kubelet runs with anonymous-auth=true and AlwaysAllow serves /pods and the rest to an unauthenticated peer. A SKIPPED here means the control cluster would not come up.
